newsitem.title: USA: Vinnell wins $31 mln Job Corps contract.
newsitem.headline: Vinnell wins $31 mln Job Corps contract.

text.p: Vinnell Corp, a unit of BDM International Inc, said on Monday it received a contract valued at about $31 million to manage a newly created Job Corps Center in Flint, Michigan.
Vinnell now managed seven such centers nationwide.
The contract was awarded competitively and covers a two-year period with three one-year options, the company said.

Vinnell said it would hire about 120 new employees in the Flint area to operate the center when it opened on January 1, 1997. Under the contract, Vinnell would manage and operate all aspects of the center, like basic education, vocational training, health education, medical services, counseling and recreational facilities for about 330 students.
